outline: This course mainly introduces the theory of game media design and game production, showing students how to cultivate game aesthetics and acquire knowledge of digital game media design. We will utilize Unity to understand the modern game engine, and we will teach you how to use Unity to develop a mini-game. Digital game development, digital game interface design, game prototyping will also be taught in class. This course will be carried out with lecture, discussion, implementation, and demonstration.
